summary: First Majestic Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K announcing the release of its 2025 Sustainability Report and the mailing of materials for its 2026 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders. The filing describes sustainability performance metrics such as carbon reduction, community investment, and safety statistics, along with standard AGM logistics. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation involved. The report is a routine disclosure of non-financial performance and meeting notice, typical for a foreign private issuer on Form 6-K.
